_comment: Curation record for the Codex + Claude Code plugin lanes (the committed plugin/ tree). Lane set = (openclaw.plugin.json#skills minus base_exclusions) plus additions. Every entry is a recorded publication decision with a reason — scripts/generate-plugin-tree.ts validates this file and test/codex-plugin-manifest.test.ts pins membership. The openclaw lane's own curation (openclaw.plugin.json + skills/plugin-exclusions.json) is untouched: a skill can be openclaw-excluded and plugin-lane-included because plugin users ARE the brain host (the downstream-vs-host inversion). starter_gaps is a generated snapshot (refresh: bun run scripts/generate-plugin-tree.ts --out plugin --write-gaps): per-skill gbrain MCP ops declared in frontmatter tools: that sit beyond the starter serve surface — every one has a first-class gbrain CLI path (see plugin/README.md), and a change here is a review-visible curation event, not silent drift.
starter_policy: cli-primary: bundled skills drive gbrain through the CLI when an op is beyond the starter MCP surface; users can widen a machine with GBRAIN_SURFACE=full (launcher-honored).

additions.setup: the plugin lane's own onboarding path (install + gbrain init + first import); swept 2026-08-15 — install command, privacy names, daemon-only prose, and repo-relative doc refs fixed for plugin consumers
additions.gbrain-upgrade: binary upgrade path — plugin users own the gbrain install; swept clean (one daemon-convention mention generalized)
additions.smoke-test: post-restart health checks; plugin users are the host — swept to make `gbrain smoke-test` the user entrypoint and label OpenClaw-service checks as conditional
additions.migrate: engine/data migration is a brain-owner activity and plugin users own their brain; swept clean
additions.frontmatter-guard: brain-page frontmatter hygiene applies to any brain owner; synthetic-name fix applied in sweep
additions.schema-author: schema-pack authoring is a brain-owner activity; repo-relative links converted for plugin consumers
additions.schema-unify: type unification is a brain-owner migration; PGLite --follow guidance + doc links fixed in sweep
additions.skill-optimizer: skillopt ships in the gbrain CLI; sweep added the read-only-snapshot note (optimize copies in your own skills dir)
additions.db-repair: plugin users ARE the brain host — the GBRAIN_DB_ACCESS marker loop needs its repair skill installed by default or the availability feature defeats itself
additions.postgres-adopt: plugin users ARE the brain host — engine detection + Postgres-first install/migration is a host-owner activity the harness lane ships by default

base_exclusions.testing: gbrain-repo development skill — instructs running this repository's own test suite; meaningless-to-harmful in a plugin snapshot
base_exclusions.skillify: writes new skills into the host repo's skill tree — repo-dev workflow, not a plugin-consumer activity
base_exclusions.skill-autobench: benchmark infrastructure for gbrain skill development; requires repo-side harnesses
base_exclusions.skillpack-harvest: writes back to openclaw.plugin.json (host-repo curation surface) — repo-dev only

coding-agent.description: Brain-first coding agent working inside a repo: retrieval, routing, ingest discipline, correction hygiene. Default persona for the claude-code harness bridge; also published as the gbrain-coding marketplace variant.

skills.query: core retrieval loop — every coding session asks the brain questions
skills.ingest: content routing into the brain — the write half of the core loop
skills.brain-ops: day-to-day brain operations (links, sync, timeline) a coding agent performs constantly
skills.repo-architecture: repository-structure capture — the coding persona's signature artifact
skills.signal-detector: detects durable signals in work sessions worth banking to the brain
skills.functional-area-resolver: two-layer skill routing keeps large skill sets navigable in coding contexts
skills.idea-ingest: capture engineering ideas with provenance while coding
skills.idea-lineage: trace how engineering decisions and ideas evolved across sessions
skills.concept-synthesis: synthesize scattered notes into concepts — turns session exhaust into knowledge
skills.enrich: backfill entities and links on pages the coding loop creates
skills.maintain: brain health checks keep a heavily-written coding brain consistent
skills.context-audit: token hygiene over CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/MEMORY — direct coding-agent pain
skills.brain-link-discipline: backlink discipline for pages the coding loop writes
skills.resolve-before-asking: resolve references from the brain before interrupting the user
skills.correction-pipeline: user corrections become durable brain updates instead of session-local fixes
skills.measure-before-you-fix: measurement discipline before performance/bug fixes — engineering hygiene
skills.brain-ingest-gate: gates what session content deserves brain ingestion — noise control
skills.data-loss-gate: guards destructive operations touching brain data during coding work
skills.db-repair: availability is the point: a coding session hitting GBRAIN_DB_ACCESS without the repair skill loses its brain mid-task
skills.postgres-adopt: engine detection by default is requirement one; the concurrency-heavy coding persona is exactly who outgrows PGLite

daily-driver.description: Personal knowledge-brain daily use: meetings, tasks, briefings, reading, research. Published as the gbrain-daily marketplace variant.

skills.query: core retrieval loop — daily questions against the brain
skills.ingest: content routing into the brain — the write half of the core loop
skills.meeting-ingestion: meeting notes and transcripts are the daily driver's highest-volume input
skills.daily-task-manager: task capture and tracking against the brain
skills.daily-task-prep: morning prep pulls tasks, meetings, and salience into one view
skills.briefing: daily/weekly briefings synthesized from brain state
skills.reports: recurring reports over brain content for personal review
skills.voice-note-ingest: voice memos land in the brain with structure
skills.media-ingest: images, PDFs, and clips filed with extraction
skills.strategic-reading: long-form reading distilled into brain pages
skills.data-research: structured research runs with sources filed as raw data
skills.perplexity-research: web research capture with citation discipline
skills.gbrain-advisor: ranked high-leverage brain actions — the daily health nudge
skills.blog-ingest: blog and article ingestion into the reading graph
skills.research-compendium: multi-source research compiled into a living compendium
skills.bulk-ingestion: batch imports (folders, exports) with manifest discipline
skills.db-repair: availability is the point: a daily-driver hitting GBRAIN_DB_ACCESS without the repair skill loses its brain mid-task
skills.postgres-adopt: engine detection by default is requirement one; 1000+ page daily brains are the pglite_scale upgrade audience
